meta.title: Tideline X-band SAR smallsat
meta.status: Concept design. Masses from CAD volumes at stated effective densities, or from catalogue values for purchased units.

honeycomb.name: Al 5056 honeycomb sandwich, 0.5 mm Al 6061 skins (effective density)

ant_core.name: CFRP-skinned Al honeycomb antenna panel (effective density)

patch.name: Rogers RO4350B patch subarray, copper radiators

trm.name: GaN T/R module (Kovar lid, LTCC substrate)

solar.name: Triple-junction GaAs cells with 100 µm coverglass

sol_core.name: CFRP / Al honeycomb solar substrate (effective density)

white.name: Aluminium radiator, white silicate paint (ε 0.9, α 0.2)

parts.name: Launch-adapter ring, 15-inch (spacecraft side)
parts.fn: Carries all launch loads into the rideshare separation system

parts.name: Array panel structure (CFRP / honeycomb)
parts.fn: Holds 136 subarrays flat to λ/16 so the beam forms correctly
parts.process: Co-cured CFRP skins on Al honeycomb, flatness 0.5 mm

parts.name: Radiating subarray, 6 patches (X-band)
parts.fn: Radiates and receives; one per T/R module

parts.name: GaN T/R module, 6 W peak
parts.fn: Amplifies the chirp on transmit and the echo on receive; sets phase for beam steering

parts.name: Panel controller and power board
parts.fn: Distributes timing, beam-steering words and 28 V to the panel’s T/R modules

parts.name: Array back radiator
parts.fn: Radiates T/R module heat to space after each imaging pass
parts.process: Painted Al sheet, bonded to TRM heat spreaders

parts.name: Deployment hinge (spring motor, damper, latch)
parts.fn: Swings a wing panel open at a controlled rate and latches it flat

parts.name: Hold-down release mechanism (SMA pin-puller)
parts.fn: Clamps a stowed wing through launch; releases on command

parts.name: Solar cell blanket, 0.58 m² triple-junction
parts.fn: About 220 W at normal sun per panel at beginning of life

parts.name: Power conditioning and distribution unit
parts.fn: Solar MPPT, battery charge, 28 V bus, latching current limiters

parts.name: Reaction wheel, 1.0 N·m·s / 0.1 N·m
parts.fn: Four in a pyramid; slews the spacecraft into imaging attitude

parts.name: AIS receiver (4-channel, 161.975 / 162.025 MHz)
parts.fn: Hears ships’ own position reports, to match against radar detections and flag dark vessels

parts.name: L-band relay modem (low-latency ship lists)
parts.fn: Sends detection lists through a commercial relay constellation within minutes

parts.name: SAR central electronics (chirp, receiver, digitiser, timing)
parts.fn: Generates the chirp, times every pulse and digitises the echoes

parts.name: Payload power unit with supercapacitor bank
parts.fn: Supplies the T/R modules’ pulsed current so the battery sees a smooth load

parts.name: Mass memory and on-board processor (1.5 TB, FPGA + GPU)
parts.fn: Stores raw data, forms images and runs ship detection on board
